decisive_spans.text: Orcein stain demonstrated reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell

response.rationale: Follicular atrophoderma is strongly supported by the presence of round atrophic lesions on the face, symmetric and bilateral, located especially on the malar and preauricular areas, and the histopathologic finding of significant epidermal dell, superficial dermal lymphocytic infiltrate associated with dermal fibrosis, and crucially, the reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell as demonstrated by Orcein stain. Discoid lupus erythematosus is a runner-up due to the atrophic lesions and lymphocytic infiltrate, but it lacks the specific finding of reduced elastic fibers and the contradiction of no previous inflammation.
